data.one_liner: Routing abstraction over Flutter navigator with nested navigation and deep links
data.what_it_does: Nuvigator provides a routing abstraction over Flutter's native navigators to model complex navigation flows using a declarative approach. It helps with large modular apps, nested navigation, deep links, and managing route relationships.
use_when: You need nested navigators with self-contained flows and proper back button handling
You are building large or modular apps requiring a unified API to register routes
You want deep linking support with path and query parameters
avoid_when: You prefer standard Flutter Navigator 2.0 or go_router without additional routing abstractions
You want a zero-configuration simple navigator for tiny apps
strengths: Handles nested navigation, Hero animations, and Android back button for children navigators
Declarative and concise API for defining routers and routes
Supports deep links with path and query parameters out of the box
weaknesses: Adds a custom abstraction layer over Flutter's navigation system
Requires learning its own router and route definition paradigms

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the official declarative routing package backed by the Flutter team with built-in deep linking.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: You prefer code generation for strongly typed arguments and automatic route generation.
